name: Neon word swap with flash
what: Bold glowing words hit one after another in the same spot, each one slamming in big and blurred and snapping to size; then a bright flash fills the frame and drops away to black, and the last, bigger word appears letter by letter and holds with its glow.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f4 (00:00:00:00-00:00:00:04) the first word slams in big and blurred and snaps to size; f15-f17 (00:00:00:15-00:00:00:17) and f30-f32 (00:00:01:00-00:00:01:02) the next two do the same, each cutting away the one before; f39 (00:00:01:09) a white flash fills the frame and turns pale yellow to f44; f40-f54 (00:00:01:10-00:00:01:24) the last word's letters appear one after another; f45-f50 (00:00:01:15-00:00:01:20) the flash drops away to black; then it holds to f89 (00:00:02:29)
